name: The Fixed 3480-Concept Reduction Excludes Two Known Proper Obstructions
statement: Let $Y$ be any ample family on fourteen active coordinates whose marked reduction is the fixed $3480$-concept input $H_*$, with both marked sections and contraction dismantlable ample. Then neither the labelled $267$-concept obstruction nor any of the $1364$-concept rectangular obstructions is a proper pc-minor of $Y$.
proof: Each target has twelve active coordinates. The inverse proper-obstruction reduction test would therefore identify one of its coordinate reductions with an image of $H_*$ under one or two old-coordinate elementary operations. The target reduction orders are $59$ and $472$. Exhausting the $39+\binom{13}{2}3^2=741$ labelled old-operation choices produces neither cardinality; a separate direct restriction/projection expression agrees with every successive-operation image. The conclusion depends only on the fixed reduction and positive marked images, so it applies to every eligible parent $Y$.
comments: This excludes the two named known witness types only and does not prove the unrestricted two-row inverse sound.
